name: Gemini CLI
tagline: Google's open-source AI agent for the terminal: build, debug and deploy with Gemini from the command line.
about: Gemini CLI brings Gemini into the terminal. It can read and edit files, run shell commands and search the web while working on a coding task.
pros: Free usage tier with a personal Google account.
Can read files, run commands and search the web.
cons: Terminal only; there is no visual editor.
The free tier has daily request limits.
